name: School Memories 2 Irreversible
original_name: スクールメモリーズ2 Irreversible
source:
It is July in Kyuunatsumachi.
A student in Kohimawari Academy, Youta Narumi
is enjoying his second summer vacation.

His days are busy in attending summer supplemental classes,
working at a convenience store with a senior female student
who he has long adored, doing volunteer work and so on.

Youta's academy life is active and fruitful despite his shy and
serious nature because of a certain goddess' help...

translation:
久那津町正值七月。
小滨瓦里学园的学生 鸣海阳太
正在享受他的第二个暑假。

他的日子忙于参加暑期补习班，
与一名高年级女学生在便利店打工
他长期以来崇拜的人，做志愿者工作等等。

尽管害羞又害羞，但尤塔的学园生活却是积极而富有成效的。
性格严肃，是因为某位女神的帮助……
